title: Chameleon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- tail: curled spiral -->
  <path d="M22 68 Q10 68 8 58 Q6 48 16 44 Q26 40 30 48 Q33 55 27 58" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="55" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#3ddc84"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="60" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#8affc1"/>
  <!-- back leg dancing up -->
  <path d="M35 65 Q30 78 38 82" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="84" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <!-- front leg dancing forward -->
  <path d="M56 64 Q62 74 72 72" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="72" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <!-- arm raised up -->
  <path d="M56 48 Q64 40 68 32" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="42" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#3ddc84"/>
  <!-- casque / crest -->
  <path d="M72 33 Q78 26 84 30 Q80 36 74 37 Z" fill="#5cf0a0"/>
  <!-- eye bump -->
  <circle cx="73" cy="40" r="6" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="40" r="4" fill="#f4ffe0"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="40" r="2" fill="#0e3b22"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M66 47 Q70 50 74 48" fill="none" stroke="#1b6b3f" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tongue flicking out -->
  <path d="M80 45 Q88 42 92 38" fill="none" stroke="#ff6fa8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="93" cy="37" r="2.5" fill="#ff6fa8"/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="3" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="60" r="2" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <!-- spot on head -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#2aa862"/>
  <!-- little music note vibes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="2.2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <path d="M52 36 L52 28 L57 30 L57 32 L53.5 31" fill="none" stroke="#ffd23f" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
</svg>
